## Purpose

React hooks layer split into two concerns: **live-run/SSE state** (transport, replay, per-run
isolation, chat transcript) and **standalone data/UX hooks** (notifications, attachments,
speech, deep-linking). Depended on by nearly every component group; itself depends on `@/lib`
(API client, SSE parsing) and `@/providers` (the app-level connection owner).

## Shape

Live-state / SSE hooks:

- [useRunStream.ts](../../frontend/src/hooks/useRunStream.ts) — the SSE run transport itself. Owns one run's down-channel (`GET
  /api/runs/{id}/events/stream` via `fetch` + `ReadableStream`, not `EventSource`, because
  `EventSource` can't carry the `Authorization` header). Implements native `Last-Event-ID`
  resume, a `connecting -> replaying -> live -> reconnecting` phase machine, exponential
  backoff capped at 30s (never gives up), keepalive drop, and silent JWT refresh ahead of
  expiry. `cursor`/`lastMessage` are deliberately refs, not `useState`, to avoid a re-render
  storm on every frame.

- [useRunStateStore.ts](../../frontend/src/hooks/useRunStateStore.ts) — per-run state store (`Map<runId, PerRunState>`) solving cross-run
  contamination when multiple pipelines run concurrently: every SSE frame writes into its own
  run's slot via `store.update(sourceRunId, ...)`, and a separate "viewport" (`viewedRunId`)
  decides what the UI currently projects. Wraps `handlePipelineMessage`/
  `deriveSpecRevisionCount` imported from [useWorkflow.ts](../../frontend/src/hooks/useWorkflow.ts).

- [useWorkflow.ts](../../frontend/src/hooks/useWorkflow.ts) (largest file, ~1200 lines) — pipeline launch (`startPipeline`, REST
  `POST /api/runs`) plus the shared `handlePipelineMessage` reducer that folds every
  `agent_*`/`pipeline_*` SSE frame into `PipelineRunState`. Exports pure, independently-tested
  helpers (`terminalMarkers`, `applyTerminalStatus`, `deriveSpecRevisionCount`) alongside the
  hook so reducer logic can be unit tested without mounting React.

- [useRunChat.ts](../../frontend/src/hooks/useRunChat.ts) — transport-agnostic, append-only chat transcript (family-anchored: a child
  revision run's frames stitch into the same array rather than replacing it). Dedupes by
  `event_id`; optimistic sends are reconciled in place when the server echo carries the same
  client-minted `message_id`.

- [useHandoffSocket.ts](../../frontend/src/hooks/useHandoffSocket.ts) — the one surviving raw WebSocket client, for the external-IDE
  handoff channel (`/ws/handoff/{token}`) that was deliberately excluded from the SSE/REST
  migration.

- [useChatAttachments.ts](../../frontend/src/hooks/useChatAttachments.ts) — chat-lane attachment intake: paste/drag-drop, client-side image
  resize via `@/lib/resizeImage`, and server-side text extraction for binary files
  (PDF/DOCX/PPTX); attachments are always `retained:false` (payload-transient, never
  persisted).

Data-fetching / UX hooks:

- [useNotifications.ts](../../frontend/src/hooks/useNotifications.ts) — localStorage-persisted pipeline notifications (schema-versioned key
  `flowin.notifications.v3`), with hydration rules that drop stale "running"/"gate"
  notifications on reload since their SSE connection no longer exists.

- [useSmoothText.ts](../../frontend/src/hooks/useSmoothText.ts) — smooths jerky bursty text deltas (chat streaming) into steady
  per-frame reveal via `requestAnimationFrame`; degrades to verbatim display when rAF is
  unavailable (tests) or disabled.

- [useSpeechRecognition.ts](../../frontend/src/hooks/useSpeechRecognition.ts) / [useTextToSpeech.ts](../../frontend/src/hooks/useTextToSpeech.ts) — thin wrappers around the browser
  `SpeechRecognition`/`SpeechSynthesis` Web APIs, each with local TS ambient declarations
  since the DOM lib doesn't ship them.

- [useTabDeepLink.ts](../../frontend/src/hooks/useTabDeepLink.ts) — a nonce'd single-use "open this tab" request/consume pair (borrowed
  from open-design), so a repeat deep-link to an already-open tab still re-triggers its
  consumer effect.

- [__fixtures__/reducerHarness.ts](../../frontend/src/hooks/__fixtures__/reducerHarness.ts) and `__tests__/*` — shared test harnesses for the
  reducer/store tests; most hook files have a co-located `.test.ts(x)` sibling plus several
  scenario-named `useWorkflow.*.test.ts` files (accumulators, reconnect, regenerate-reset,
  spec-revision-count, clarify-retention, image-payload) covering specific historical bugs.

## Why this shape

The split between transport (`useRunStream`), fan-out/isolation (`useRunStateStore`, owned by
`RunConnectionProvider`), and reduction (`useWorkflow`'s `handlePipelineMessage`) exists
because **a single React closure inside dashboard/page.tsx used to own all of it** —
untestable and prone to cross-run cross-talk once multiple pipelines could run concurrently.

Pulling the reducer and dedup/replay decisions into named, exported pure functions
(`terminalMarkers`, `shouldApplyEvent`-style logic in `@/lib/wsReplayState`) makes the
historical bug fixes (BUG-013 through BUG-021, [ISS-082](../cards/20260812-0351-ISS-082.md), [FIX-201](../cards/20260807-1633-FIX-201.md)/202) independently
regression-tested. `useRunStream` chooses `fetch`+`ReadableStream` over `EventSource`
specifically to carry the JWT bearer token — a deliberate deviation from the "just use
EventSource" default.

The non-SSE hooks (notifications, speech, deep-link, smooth-text) are kept in the same
directory despite having no live-state dependency because they're still cross-cutting,
reusable-across-components concerns, not owned by any single feature area.
